items.question: How many riggers aboard the C-Enforcer were hurt when the Island Venture's crane wire parted and the wire reel fell onto the deck?
items.expected_answer: The premise is wrong: nobody was hurt; the rigging crew on the C-Enforcer and the crane operator on the Island Venture were uninjured, and no injuries were reported.

evidence.quote: The rigging crew on the C-Enforcer and the crane operator on Island Venture were uninjured.
There were no injuries, and no pollution was reported.

items.notes: False premise that riggers were injured by the falling wire reel; the report states there were no injuries.

items.question: What was the estimated property damage to the C-Enforcer and to the Island Venture in the crane wire failure at Port Fourchon?
items.expected_answer: Property damage was estimated at $3.8 million in total: $766,000 for the C-Enforcer and $3 million for the Island Venture.

evidence.quote: Property damage  $3.8 million est; $766,000 (C-Enforcer), $3 million (Island Venture)

items.notes: Tests extraction of the per-vessel damage split from the casualty summary table (the narrative only gives the $3.8 million total).
